messages.subject: Defence and Counterclaim received - what it means
messages.plaintextBody:
Owen, Karen,

Crayford's Defence and Counterclaim arrived yesterday. As expected they deny breach and blame (a) out-of-spec feed (oversize boulders / abrasion) and (b) operator misuse and missed servicing. They counterclaim the £142,500 retention.

The good news: your diary, the grease checklists and the fact you screen to minus 600mm answer the misuse and oversize points squarely. The real contest is the engineering cause, which is why Dr Petrie's report matters. Karen - can you pull the 200- and 500-hour service sign-offs so we can exhibit them?

Tom
